evidence.why: Pickup calls the helper before selecting index 1; held callbacks are passive.

facts.rationale: Corrects the misleading absence-of-timer claim by following the shared helper's writes across the call boundary.
facts.value: On pickup, unconditionally initializes xD44_lifeTimer from Hammer Head special attribute x4 and xD48_halfLifeTimer from that value multiplied by global x4C_float through it_80275158, then enters table index 1 with ITEM_ANIM_UPDATE. The held animation and physics callbacks do not advance the free-item lifetime countdown.

evidence.why: Both table indices register this animation callback.

facts.rationale: Explicitly captures shared initial/released use rather than describing only state 2, while preserving the priority of expiration over threshold processing.
facts.value: Updates the Hammer Head's remaining lifetime in both initial table index 0 and dropped/thrown index 2. Each invocation decrements xD44_lifeTimer, immediately returns true if the result is nonpositive, and otherwise calls it_802728C8 when the updated timer is at or below global x34 before returning false.

evidence.why: Complete forwarding and state-entry data flow.
Flag 1 and animation-update flag 2 are distinct.

facts.rationale: Corrects the numeric flag interpretation and includes both registered incoming states without inventing additional velocity or timer writes.
facts.value: Receives the Hammer Head Item_GObj through it_80299F94 from collision processing shared by table indices 0 and 2. It obtains the Item, sets x40_vel.y and x40_vel.x to zero, calls it_8026B390 with the original object, and calls Item_80268E5C with table index 3 and literal flag 1 (ITEM_UNK_0x1, not ITEM_ANIM_UPDATE). It does not directly write Z velocity or lifetime.

evidence.why: Literal transition flag and complete resting callback trio.
Support-loss callback and shared exceptional branch.

facts.rationale: Preserves the supported resting-state behavior while removing the incorrect claim that the transition requests animation updating.
facts.value: Unconditionally clears horizontal and vertical velocity, performs shared item setup, and enters Hammer Head table index 3 with flag 1 (ITEM_UNK_0x1); it does not request the ITEM_ANIM_UPDATE bit. The entry routine contains no local guard or timer write. Index 3 continues lifetime processing, has empty local physics, and delegates support monitoring with the thrown-state handler as its support-loss callback.

evidence.why: Caller supplies its owner rather than the Hammer object itself.

facts.rationale: Corrects the overly narrow parent-item characterization and preserves the actual source/header spellings and caller relationship.
facts.value: Dedicated item translation unit with a four-entry ItemStateTable. Its void constructor receives a parent/owner game object, position and launch-direction Vec3 pointers, and f32 facing direction. The definition spells the first parameter Item_GObj*, while the public header spells it HSD_GObj*; the Hammer caller supplies its owner, so the parent must not be assumed to carry an Item payload.
